title: Preserve the Invariant and Make Progress
summary: Maintain a condition that stays true after every step while ensuring each step strictly reduces or advances the remaining work.
recognition_signals: state changes one step at a time
correctness depends on a condition staying true
a loop or search can stall if boundaries do not move
core_rules: State the invariant in terms of already-processed and not-yet-processed data.
Every non-terminal iteration must either advance a frontier or shrink the remaining candidate set.
structural_steps: define what the maintained state means before the loop
perform one update without breaking that meaning
move the relevant pointer or boundary
check the invariant again at the next iteration

common_confusions.distinction: Boundary binary search is one specific use of invariant-and-progress reasoning on an ordered candidate interval; this family applies more broadly to loops and pointer algorithms.
